people.name: Elliot Sperling
people.field: historians of Tibet and Tibetan-Chinese relations

relations.subject: Elliot Sperling
relations.evidence: Attending Queens College in the early 1970s at the height of the counterculture movement only served to kindle in him a youthful idealism that was never extinguished.

relations.subject: Elliot Sperling
relations.evidence: Sperling matriculated at Indiana University's Department of Uralic and Altaic Studies... and wrote his doctoral dissertation, Early Ming Policy toward Tibet... in 1983.

relations.subject: Taktser Rinpoche
relations.evidence: The department was already internationally renowned, in part owing to the presence on the faculty of Taktser Rinpoche, the Dalai Lama's eldest brother.

relations.subject: Elliot Sperling
relations.evidence: Sperling took his first faculty position also at a public institution, the University of Southern Mississippi (USM).

relations.subject: Elliot Sperling
relations.evidence: Sperling returned to Indiana University in 1987, as a faculty member. He would remain at the university, a much-loved teacher, until December 2015

relations.subject: Elliot Sperling
